record.paper_title: Properly Coloured Cycles and Paths: Results and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Weakened degree condition for long properly coloured cycles
record.original_question: Let G be a c-edge-coloured multigraph on n vertices. If the minimum monochromatic degree satisfies δ_mon(G) ≥ ceil(n/2), must G always contain a Hamilton properly coloured cycle when c ≥ 3, and when c = 2 with n even, and a properly coloured cycle of length n - 1 when c = 2 with n odd?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 5.2. [1] Theorem 5.1 holds if we replace δmon(G) ≥ ⌈n+1/2⌉ by δmon(G) ≥ ⌈n/2⌉.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a c-edge-coloured multigraph on n vertices, where each edge is assigned one of c colours and multiple edges between the same pair of vertices are allowed (each edge bearing its own colour). For a vertex v, the monochromatic degree of v is defined as the maximum, over the colours i ∈ {1,…,c}, of the number of edges of colour i incident with v; the minimum monochromatic degree δ_mon(G) is the minimum of this quantity over all vertices of G. A cycle (respectively, path) in G is properly coloured if every two consecutive edges along it have distinct colours. A Hamilton properly coloured cycle is a properly coloured cycle that visits every vertex exactly once.

Prove or disprove the following:

(a) If c ≥ 3 and δ_mon(G) ≥ ⌈n/2⌉, then G contains a Hamilton properly coloured cycle.

(b) If c = 2, n is even, and δ_mon(G) ≥ ⌈n/2⌉, then G contains a Hamilton properly coloured cycle.

(c) If c = 2, n is odd, and δ_mon(G) ≥ ⌈n/2⌉, then G contains a properly coloured cycle of length n − 1.
artifact.category_tag: edge-coloured graphs and properly coloured cycles
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is a strengthening (weakening of the degree hypothesis from ⌈(n+1)/2⌉ to ⌈n/2⌉) of a known theorem on properly coloured Hamilton cycles in edge-coloured multigraphs. Related work on monochromatic-degree conditions for properly coloured cycles exists, and the Bollobás–Erdős conjecture for edge-coloured complete graphs has been resolved asymptotically, but no source clearly confirming a resolution of this specific multigraph conjecture with the ⌈n/2⌉ threshold was found.

status_evidence.title: Monochromatic-degree conditions for properly colored cycles in edge-colored complete graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Studies monochromatic-degree conditions guaranteeing properly colored cycles in edge-colored complete graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to investigate monochromatic-degree thresholds for properly colored cycles, but the specific multigraph conjecture with δ_mon ≥ ⌈n/2⌉ does not appear resolved here.

status_evidence.title: Properly coloured Hamiltonian cycles in edge-coloured complete graphs (Combinatorica)
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes the Bollobás–Erdős conjecture asymptotically for edge-coloured complete graphs.
status_evidence.claim: The closely related Bollobás–Erdős conjecture for complete graphs is known only asymptotically, suggesting that the corresponding tight multigraph conjecture is still open.
